root_cause: GeometricEncounterClock emitted and consumed every Poisson passage across one PF geometry increment, but the GB/TJ caller converted only the first passage into a blocked state. Passages later than the state-changing first encounter were silently discarded even though the physical state no longer admitted continued easy motion.
corrections: GeometricEncounterClock can stop at a caller-declared passage count and retains its hazard and reaction-coordinate state at the exact first encounter.
GB and TJ compatibility creation request one encounter because the first passage changes mobility state.
Ungated geometric-process uses retain complete multi-passage sampling.
An explicit TJ Burgers residual blocks directly without consuming an unrelated geometric encounter.
policy: All partial checkpoints, event ledgers, and trajectories remain in place. They are excluded from final inference, and the full 165-run matrix is relaunched from the corrected tested SHA.
